g1_unwrap_labor.name: stage
g1_unwrap_labor.sql:
CREATE TEMP TABLE hkm33_unwrap ON COMMIT DROP AS
SELECT a.id, a."lawName", a."articleNumber" n, a."articleBis" bis, a.content previous_text,
  btrim(substring(a.content from '["«]\s*(.*?)\s*["»]')) new_text,
  btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(a.content, '["«]\s*.*?\s*["»]', '[النص]'), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) note_text,
  coalesce(substring(a.content from '(المرسوم الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*وتاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)'), substring(a.content from '(قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*وتاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)'), substring(a.content from '(الأمر الملكي رقم\s*\([^)]*\)\s*وتاريخ\s*[0-9/]+هـ)')) instrument,
  substring(a.content from 'وتاريخ\s*([0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2})هـ') hijri
FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."lawName"='نظام العمل' AND ((a."articleNumber" IN (233,234,235) AND a."articleBis"=0) OR (a."articleNumber"=229 AND a."articleBis"=1))

g1_unwrap_labor.name: guard_before
g1_unwrap_labor.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM hkm33_unwrap)=4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hkm33_unwrap WHERE new_text IS NULL OR length(new_text)<30 OR instrument IS NULL OR hijri IS NULL)=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hkm33_unwrap u WHERE position(u.new_text in u.previous_text)=0)=0 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source_id='hkm033-unwrap-2026-10-23')=0 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END guard

g1_unwrap_labor.name: provenance
g1_unwrap_labor.sql:
INSERT INTO legal_text_provenance (id, entity_type, entity_id, law_name, article_number, source, source_id, source_url, text_sha, retrieved_on, action, previous_text, created_at)
SELECT 'hkm33p-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to('unwrap|'||id,'UTF8')),'hex'),24), 'article', id, "lawName", n, 'boe', 'hkm033-unwrap-2026-10-23', 'internal:hakeem/legal_articles/'||id, encode(sha256(convert_to(previous_text,'UTF8')),'hex'), '2026-10-23'::date, 'unwrap_amendment_note', previous_text, now() FROM hkm33_unwrap

g1_unwrap_labor.name: article_amendments
g1_unwrap_labor.sql:
INSERT INTO article_amendments (id, "articleId", version, "changeType", "decreeRef", "effectiveFrom", "hijriDate", summary, "previousText", "newText", source, "reviewStatus", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 'hkm33a-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to('added|'||id,'UTF8')),'hex'),24), id, 1, 'added', instrument, NULL, hijri, 'HKM-033: '||note_text, previous_text, new_text, 'boe', 'pending', now(), now() FROM hkm33_unwrap

g1_unwrap_labor.name: content
g1_unwrap_labor.sql: UPDATE legal_articles a SET content = u.new_text, "updatedAt" = now() FROM hkm33_unwrap u WHERE a.id=u.id

g1_unwrap_labor.name: search_norm
g1_unwrap_labor.sql: UPDATE legal_articles a SET search_norm = uqn_fix.hkm30_search_norm(a."lawName", a.title, a.content, a.keywords, a.classification, a.chapter) FROM hkm33_unwrap u WHERE a.id=u.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id AND v.valid_from <= now())

g1_unwrap_labor.name: guard_after
g1_unwrap_labor.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles a JOIN hkm33_unwrap u ON u.id=a.id WHERE a.content=u.new_text)=4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM article_amendments WHERE id LIKE 'hkm33a-%')=4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_text_provenance WHERE source_id='hkm033-unwrap-2026-10-23')=4 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END guard

g1_unwrap_labor.name: report
g1_unwrap_labor.sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(a.id||'|'||a.content, '|' ORDER BY a.id)) fp, json_agg(json_build_object('n',u.n,'bis',u.bis,'instrument',u.instrument,'hijri',u.hijri,'new',a.content) ORDER BY u.n,u.bis) rows FROM hkm33_unwrap u JOIN legal_articles a ON a.id=u.id

g2_tag.name: tag_attachments
g2_tag.sql: UPDATE legal_articles SET status='مرفق', "updatedAt"=now() WHERE id IN ('cmr4rvo2v00bh1j0uuysgwvyj', 'cmr4rvo2v00bi1j0uz42h4akg', 'cmr4rvo2v00bj1j0uqofxdo40', 'cmpz626hg03ghcwg2ts0cisj9', 'cmpz626ne03gjcwg2gh8j1cqn', 'cmpz626tc03glcwg2bthl2rng', 'cmpzcv6wn0aa3vtrkxa0bmnmr') AND "articleBis">=100

g2_tag.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE status='مكررة' AND "articleBis">=100)=14 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE status='مرفق' AND "articleBis">=100)=7 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "articleBis">=100)=31 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM legal_articles WHERE "articleBis"<100 AND status IN ('مكررة','مرفق'))=0 THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END guard

g2_tag.name: report
g2_tag.sql: SELECT status, count(*) n, string_agg("lawName"||' '||"articleNumber", '، ' ORDER BY "lawName","articleNumber") rows FROM legal_articles WHERE "articleBis">=100 GROUP BY status ORDER BY 1
